My 101yo grandmother passed away last night and I am very sad. But she has given me a weird perspective I had not considered any day before today. She was 52 when I was born in 1976. I am going to be 50 next month. She lived an entire life all over again in the time that I have been alive. The coolest thing about my grandmother more than the fact that she was a badass and didn't put up with any bullshit was that she was standing in the front row of the Paramount theater when Frank Sinatra played there. She cut school to go see him. She told me that he smiled at her and that made the inevitable punishment she was going to get from my great-grandfather even better. But my great-grandfather didn't punish her. He simply smiled at her when she told him what she had done and said "I would have done the same thing." 😂 My grandmother wasn't conventional. She didn't smoke like other people her age. She hated to wear dresses and preferred pants instead and that garnered her a lot of weird looks. She made a home out of a very tiny apartment in Brooklyn that felt like a palace and which I ran through as a child with wild abandon. She had been engaged to this guy named Vinny who broke off the engagement and later tried to rekindle their love and she told him to fuck off. That he was only going to break her heart once and to go back to his mother and hang on her apron strings. 😂 When my grandfather (my grandmother had gone on a few dates with him prior to his leaving for war) got back from WWII and heard that she had broke off her engagement with his rival he showed up at her house in his uniform, knocked on the door and asked her to go on a date with him. He literally stepped back onto New York ground and the first thing he did before going to see any of his family or even going to get lunch was go find my grandmother so he could lock her in as his lady love. She told him she had to think about it and to come back later, then slammed the door in his face. So he came back later. The next day and the day after that and each day she thanked him for his visit but closed the door in his face. This went on for several months until some neighbors and family members intervened and invited him to dinner. My grandfather maybe said 20 words his entire life and most of those 20 words were said during that dinner. He was a very quiet man but he loved my grandmother fiercely. And so he told her during that dinner that he wanted to marry her but he had to save up for an engagement ring, but that would take a year. He asked her to be patient and not see anyone else because according to my grandfather who later told me this story over several years because like I said he didn't say a lot of words in one sitting, grandma "was a real looker" and he was afraid she would go out with somebody else. So as he's eating along with family at this dinner and he makes this awkward pre proposal, she gives him a nasty look and says "I'm not waiting a year. If you want to marry me then we'll get married within 3 months." Which was around the time that the Catholic Church took to give a dispensation. Grandpa was so thrilled with what she said that he never considered she didn't actually say yes, she gave him an ultimatum instead which he gladly accepted.😂 And 3 months later they were married. I would always tease her that she was so mean to Grandpa but she told me that she loved him very much but she couldn't show it because he had to go away to war and there was a chance that he would be killed so she had to harden her heart. She said a lot of girls had to do that in that day because a lot of men didn't come home. And she said she was lucky that he did. I could write so much more. Maybe I will later. I'm too sad right now. So many memories. I loved and love her so much. She was an incredible human being and I am so fortunate to have been her second grandchild. Rest in peace Grandma.♥️

The MoU enables exchange of research, scientific & technical materials, pursue collaborative research programs in specific fields of interest and sharing of instrumentation facility.

Last time on Dragon Ball Z: I made a long ass post discussing my Benzodiazepine dependency. Lots of people sent me DMs, or left comments, calling me "brave", or something (is addiction and/or dependency taboo or something?). People also DMd me saying they also have Benzodiazepine dependency but were too scared to try to taper due to how dangerous the drug can be. Behind the scenes I've basically been a test dummy for some people. Let me share with all of you how cool and badass my taper has been > be me > on benzos for 14 years > not supposed to do more than 90 days > everyone like "wtf bro" > decide to do 25% reduction in dosage > people call me crazy > withdrawals start after two days, or something > day two arrives > insanely high anxiety > heart sometimes races > sometimes feel really hot > sometimes legs feel like jelly > sometimes really grumpy > weird withdrawals arent nonstop > comes in waves seemingly randomly > sometimes better, sometimes worse > not too bad, honestly > really, really, really bad insomnia tho > day five > every clams down > shrimple, not too bad > consult with addiction specialist to help insomnia > give me sleeping pills (trazadone) > "go to hospital if you get dangerous erection" > okay? > hold previous 25% cut for a few weeks > decide to aggressively taper again > another 25% cut > total reduction would be 50% > start > day two arrives > feel really sad > doesnt feel like depression > feel "blue", just low energy and kind of mopey > everything in my life great > no reason to be sad > legs sometimes feel like jello > anxiety back > heart race sometimes > heart sometimes beat really hard > mostly really sad The sadness feels like I'm a 14 year old boy in math class whos crush (Susie Bananas, straight A student, champion of the Spelling Bee) recently told you in secret she has a crush on Joseph FastFeet (fastest kid in school), and now you're sad and have to listen to really emo music in your bedroom while your parents make you pancakes for dinner. It's not crippling depression, but you just feel kind of emotional. The weird heart beat thingie is like, you'll be laying in bed and it's like your heart turned the bass up to fuck off level. I'm in bed and it feels like my heart is punching the mattress through my back. It's interesting. Overall the taper hasn't been too bad. India is the world's largest producer and exporter of rice, yet the Food Corporation of India (FCI) is holding rice stocks that are nearly five times the prescribed buffer norm, at a carrying cost of over Rs. 10,712 crores in FY25. In their latest article, Ashok Gulati, Ritika Juneja, and Purvi Thangaraj trace this surplus to three interlinked policy distortions: open-ended MSP procurement, with several states offering bonuses above the MSP; free electricity and heavily subsidised urea. Instead of addressing these underlying distortions, the government's response has been to divert surplus rice to ethanol production, supplying rice to distilleries at Rs. 23/kg despite FCI's economic cost of about Rs. 44/kg on the justification that it is broken and damaged rice. The authors also highlight the environmental costs of the current policy framework, including the use of ~ 4,000 litres of water to produce one kilogram of rice, high methane emissions from paddy cultivation, and nitrate contamination of groundwater associated with serious health risks. To address these challenges, the authors recommend capping state procurement at 40% of production, discontinuing state MSP bonuses, limiting free PDS supplies to the most vulnerable households, shifting ethanol production towards maize, and replacing fertiliser subsidies with direct income support. Early this morning, members of Florida Task Force 1 (#FLTF1) and Florida Task Force 2 (#FLTF2) returned home after supporting the @StateDept humanitarian mission in Venezuela following the devastating earthquakes. There are moments that remind us why we train for years, why we answer the call without hesitation, and why service reaches far beyond the uniform. For the members of FL-TF1 and FL-TF2, this mission meant leaving their own families behind to stand beside families whose lives changed in an instant. To many Venezuelans, both in their homeland and here in South Florida, these responders became a symbol of hope during one of life’s darkest moments. In Venezuela, they searched through devastation, worked shoulder to shoulder with local and international responders, and never lost sight of the people behind every search. They witnessed unimaginable loss, extraordinary resilience, and a community coming together, refusing to give up. Today, they return home to the families who patiently waited for them, carrying stories they will never forget and the privilege of having served when they were needed most. Welcome home, FL-TF1 and FL-TF2. Miami-Dade is proud of you. South Florida is proud of you. Thank you for showing the world what compassion, courage, and service look like. @usembassyve Video

Last December, the FBI announced Operation Red Circus, our ongoing effort to disrupt Russian state-sponsored cyber threats to the United States and our interests abroad. As part of that announcement, the FBI and partners released a joint Cybersecurity Advisory on pro-Russia hacktivist groups conducting opportunistic attacks against critical infrastructure, including the water, agriculture, and energy sectors. A mission priority of Operation Red Circus is targeting and arresting individuals for their roles in hacktivist groups such as Cyber Army of Russia Reborn to mitigate planned, malicious cyber-campaigns. This action is part of Operation Riptide and underscores the FBI’s commitment to working with our international partners to disrupt and hold accountable those engaged in malicious cyber activity. Together, we will continue to impose costs on cybercriminals wherever they operate.

The borderless threat of cyberattacks continues to pose high risk on countries across the globe. To combat these threats, the FBI remains committed to working with international partners, such as the Spanish National Police, in order to deter and impose consequences on malicious cybercriminal groups. @policia Video

For the IT admins & security folks who are unaware... In Windows Server 2025, RPC over named pipes (via SMB) for the Print Spooler is disabled by default. I believe this started with Windows Server 2022 23H2 and up. Also EFS is now similar to WebClient where it can be targeted but has to be activated first. There's a netexec module to perform this one for inquiring minds... It's also common to see DFS on Domain Controllers but of course it's not enabled by default. So tools like Coercer seem to not be too successful against Server 2025 in basic out of the box configurations.

#Delhi is set to introduce #ChildProtectionCommittees in all 5,633 schools across the capital by the end of July, making child safety a permanent part of the education system rather than a temporary campaign. The decision was taken during a meeting chaired by LG #TaranjitSinghSandhu and CM #RekhaGupta at Raj Niwas. The initiative covers Delhi government schools, government-aided schools, MCD, NDMC and Delhi Cantonment Board schools, as well as private schools. The government has also directed that counsellors be made available in every school, with students receiving sessions on safe and unsafe touch, personal boundaries, gender sensitisation and self-defence. Authorities have been asked to implement a comprehensive student safety checklist, operationalise SOPs for handling POCSO cases, and conduct joint school inspections involving parents, education officials, police and school heads. Officials said the objective is to build a long-term child protection system that ensures every child in Delhi studies in a safe and secure environment.

Candidate for the position of United Nations Secretary-General, H.E. Ms. María Fernanda Espinosa, calls on Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif. Islamabad, 6 July 2026.

Islamabad: 6 July 2026. Candidate for the position of United Nations Secretary-General, H.E. Ms. María Fernanda Espinosa, called on Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif at the Prime Minister House today. While welcoming Ms. Espinosa, the Prime Minister expressed Pakistan’s longstanding commitment to multilateralism, as well as the high significance it has always attached to the United Nations. While reaffirming this abiding commitment to the UN, the Prime Minister expressed the hope that the incoming leadership of the United Nations will continue to work towards promoting the three pillars of the United Nations in a balanced manner through adherence to the purposes and principles of the UN Charter, faithful implementation of UN Security Council resolutions, respect for international law and treaties, and active international cooperation among Member States within the framework of the UN Charter to promote global peace and prosperity. Ms. Espinosa thanked the Prime Minister for receiving her and praised Pakistan for its leading role in recent regional peace efforts as well as its active participation in the United Nations over the past many decades. Ms.Espinosa had previously visited Pakistan in 2019 in her capacity as President of the United Nations General Assembly. Video

Et voici ce qui semble être une photo du tir chinois de ce matin. Pour rappel il est très difficile, voire impossible, de différencier un JL-2 d'un JL-3 sur une photo, puisque le "JL-3" présenté le 3 septembre dernier lors du défilé des 80 ans de la victoire sur le Japon était en fait la maquette d'un JL-2 sur laquelle le nom avait été effacé pour être remplacé par JL-3. Pour ce test c'est probablement la portée qui donne l'indice le plus probant, le JL-3 étant crédité d'une portée plus longue, de l'ordre de 10 000 km. On notera que ni la Corée du Sud, ni le Japon ne se sont offusqués d'un survol de leur territoire durant ce test, ce qui aurait dû être le cas en cas de tir depuis la Mer de Bohai, ce qui tend à privilégier l'hypothèse d'un tir depuis la Mer de Chine Méridionale, au large de Hong Kong et Macao. Etienne Marcuz (@Etienne_Marcuz) 🇨🇳🚀 Tir de missile depuis un SNLE chinois ☢️🇨🇳 La Chine a procédé tôt ce matin (06h01 heure de Paris) à un tir inédit de missile balistique depuis l'un de ses sous-marins nucléaires lanceurs d'engins (SLBM tiré par un SNLE). Si Pékin tire régulièrement ce type de missile d'Est en Ouest pour que la charge retombe sur son propre territoire, l'événement de ce matin se démarque par une retombée dans le Pacifique, à plus de 7200 km de distance du point de tir. C'est notable pour deux raisons: - ce type de trajectoire permet de tester l'engin à portée maximale, alors que les tests habituels utilisent des trajectoires en cloche (~3000 km). Les contraintes thermiques et mécaniques sont différentes. Il s'agissait d'ailleurs du premier tir SLBM chinois à portée maximale. - cela permet aux compétiteurs stratégiques, et notamment aux Etats-Unis, d'évaluer les performances du système d'armes, notamment en termes de comportement lors de la rentrée atmosphérique et de précision. L'USAF avait d'ailleurs déployé l'un de ses rares avions de télémesure COBRA BALL sur la zone. Ce test est donc avant tout une démonstration de crédibilité de la dissuasion chinoise à l'heure du retour de la compétition entre grandes puissances. Rappelons que les SNLE servent à la frappe en second et doivent donc garantir à tout adversaire la capacité de la Chine à répondre de manière massive à une attaque, même surprise, menaçant ses intérêts vitaux. Notons que la Chine a fait preuve de responsabilité en notifiant en amont les pays de la région la tenue de ce test, ainsi qu'en déposant des restrictions à la navigation aérienne et maritime. Toutefois, ces restrictions pointent justement vers une possible anomalie. En effet, la Chine a revendiqué le tir d'un SLBM. Or, les restrictions indiquaient que deux tirs devaient avoir lieu, l'un depuis la Mer de Bohai et l'autre depuis la Mer de Chine Méridionale, soit les deux bastions des SNLE chinois. Il est donc possible que l'un des deux SNLE ait connu un dysfonctionnement, l'empêchant de tirer son missile. Toutefois, plusieurs créneaux étaient prévus pour ce test, courant jusqu'au 8 juillet. Patientons donc jusque là... 📸 SLBM chinois JL-2 durant un défilé militaire, modèle qui a probablement été tiré ce matin. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/Etienne_Marcuz/status/2074050194564420051#m

My husband and I are honored and thrilled to participate in the Invest America program and gift a share of our SpaceX stock to a Trump Account for each of more than two million children across our great nation. Every American child under 18 can benefit from having a Trump Account, but our gift specifically goes to the Accounts of children (ages 11-17) that live in areas with lower average household incomes with a bit more emphasis for those that live near our central Texas home. We have been fortunate in our careers and hope this gift encourages the next generation to continue the journey of enabling humanity to live and fly amongst the stars. A huge thanks to all that worked to bring this incredible program to life. Brad Gerstner (@altcap) Dear America, Starting today, on the 250th birthday of our country, millions of children will now benefit from a new & powerful American birthright - a privately owned investment account from birth. Every child a shareholder in the great American economy! American capitalism is the greatest prosperity-creating engine the world has ever known. It has unlocked unprecedented abundance for our country and untold life-advancing innovation. From clean food & water to cars & planes to vaccines & cures to computers & phones. Through depressions & world wars, through panics & pandemics, betting on America has been the best investment in human history. But far too many hardworking families feel like they are on the outside looking in - like the American Dream has become out of reach. The Invest America Act changes all that. Signed into law by President Trump it establishes the Trump Accounts - launching today - making every child a shareholder from birth. Every account seeded with $1000 in America's best companies - making every child a direct participant in our stock markets & American capitalism. But it doesn’t stop there. Representing the best of our civic traditions, an unprecedented outpouring of additional private contributions into these accounts is already underway. Billions of dollars have been committed by philanthropists & corporations to tens of millions of children across the country. A new form of massive, direct philanthropy & corporate benefits directly to America’s kids is just getting started. From adopting all the kids of a school or organization to a city or state. America is the most giving country in the history of the world - and Trump Accounts provide a new open source platform to enable anybody to contribute to anybody. Trillions of dollars will compound in these accounts over the next 20 years. But this is about more than just figures on an account statement. By investing in the next generation, our country is providing tangible opportunities to all future generations of Americans: an education, a first home, the ability to start a business, and the foundation for a lifetime of savings. Trump Accounts provide hope to those feeling hopeless - unlocking unlimited human potential. Trump Accounts do this through a massive public - private partnership that empower the individual not the state. They double down on free market capitalist democracy by empowering the individual rather than growing dependency on government. Aligning citizens with capitalism rather than pitting them against it. Perhaps of equal importance, let us not lose sight of the fact that this is a movement that unites our country. Despite the many issues that divide us, this one big idea brings everyone together. From the most conservative to the most progressive leaders, we have found people of goodwill willing to step up and do the right thing to help the next generation. Trump Accounts represent the very best of our democracy and the American promise issued two hundred and fifty years ago today. I am grateful to all those who have partnered with us to get this far and we dedicate our tireless efforts to make certain that the Invest America Act achieves its maximum potential. Let us advance into the future with a renewed sense of confidence, optimism and restored faith in the American Dream for EVERY American. Happy 250th Birthday, America! Warm felicitations to President Donald J. Trump and the people of the United States on the historic occasion of the 250th Anniversary of American Independence. Pakistan joins the United States in celebrating this remarkable milestone and the enduring values of freedom, resilience, and democracy. NIOT Expresses Gratitude to the Indian Coast Guard for Swift Recovery of ANMS Buoy NIOT-MOES expresses its sincere gratitude to the Indian Coast Guard, and the Captain and crew of ICGS Rani Gaidinliu, for their swift response and exemplary support in recovering NIOT's indigenously developed Ambient Noise Measurement System (ANMS) Buoy, which had drifted more than 150 km away from its deployed location off the Nellore coast following suspected vandalism that also caused damage to the buoy. The ANMS Buoy is a vital ocean observation system that continuously monitors the underwater acoustic environment, generating valuable data for oceanographic research, coastal ecosystem studies, and rainfall studies. Owing to the prompt action and seamless coordination of the Indian Coast Guard, the buoy was successfully recovered and safely handed over to NIOT's hired boat off Nizampatnam Port. This timely assistance reflects the Indian Coast Guard's unwavering commitment to safeguarding India's valuable marine scientific assets and supporting ocean research.

🚨Javier Aguirre on Jude Bellingham: 🗣️ Reporter: “What made Jude Bellingham so difficult for your team to deal with tonight?” 🗣️ Javier Aguirre: “It’s not just his quality. We prepared for his quality. What makes him so difficult is that he never stays in one place. One minute he’s helping in midfield, the next he’s arriving in the box like a centre-forward. You think you’ve picked him up, then he disappears from your line of sight for one second… and that’s enough. For his first goal, we had defenders in the right positions. But Jude attacked the space with perfect timing. For the second goal, exactly the same story. He reads the game half a second quicker than everybody else. Players like that punish the smallest mistake. You can spend the whole week analysing them, showing videos, working on defensive shape… but if you lose concentration for one moment, he’s there. Tonight, that’s exactly what happened. We didn’t lose because we didn’t respect Jude Bellingham. We lost because, for two moments, we couldn’t stop him from doing what world-class players do.

All eyes on Earth 👀 Airbus is making a further contribution to the world’s largest environmental programme, Europe’s @CopernicusEU. 🌍 We just completed testing of the second Copernicus Sentinel-4 air quality monitoring optical instrument, which will continuously monitor the atmosphere above Europe to track pollutants and gases. Why does this matter? Understanding what is in our atmosphere helps us better manage the risks of natural threats like desert dust, volcanic ash, and even pollen. 🔎 This data will enable scientists, environmental agencies and policymakers to study the composition of the air that European citizens breathe, and adapt European public health policies. What matters in Space matters on Earth, and Earth observation satellites are a vital tool to monitor the effects of climate change on natural ecosystems. In fact more than 50% of climate variables can only be measured from Space. That is what the Copernicus programme is all about: providing the insights we need to understand climate and guide efforts on the ground to face environmental challenges.🌿 The Copernicus programme is a joint initiative between the European Union (EU) and the European Space Agency (@ESA).

اسلام آباد: 6 جولائی 2026. وزیرِ اعظم محمد شہباز شریف کی زیرِ صدارت نوجوانوں کو روزگار مہیا کرنے کے حوالے سے جائزہ اجلاس آج اسلام آباد میں منعقد ہوا. اجلاس سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے وزیرِ اعظم نے کہا کہ بیرون ملک پاکستانی سفارتخانے پاکستانی افرادی قوت کیلئے روزگار کے مواقع کی تلاش میں تیزی لے کر آئیں. وزیرِ اعظم نے ہدایات کیں کہ پروٹیکٹریٹ آف امیگریشن کے تمام تر نظام کو ڈیجیٹائیز کیا جائے اور افرادی قوت بالخصوص نوجوانوں کو وزارت برائے سمندر پار مقیم پاکستانی، نیووٹیک اور یوتھ پروگرام ہنر اور مختلف زبانوں کے کورسس بمعہ سرٹیفیکیشنز یقینی بنائیں. وزیرِ اعظم نے مزید کہا کہ پاکستان کی افرادی قوت با صلاحیت ہے، بین الاقوامی معیار کی تعلیم و عالمی سطح پر رسائی کیلئے ہر ممکن اقدام اٹھا رہے ہیں. پاکستانی سفارتخانے بیرون ملک میسر روزگار کے مواقع سے آگاہی اور ڈیٹا کی فراہمی کیلئے اقدامات تیز کریں. پاکستانی سرٹیفیکیشنز کو بین الاقوامی معیار سے ہم آہنگ کرنے کیلئے تمام ادارے مختلف ممالک سے روابط مضبوط کرے. جن ممالک میں پاکستانی ہنرمند افراد کیلئے روزگار کے مواقع میسر ہیں، انکی زبان کی تعلیم بمعہ سرٹیفیکیشنز یقینی بنائی جائے. وزیرِ اعظم نے مزید کہا کہ نیووٹیک (NAVTTC) کے تحت تکنیکی و فنی تربیت کے اداروں کی کارکردگی اور کنٹری آف ڈیسٹینیشن سینٹرز کے قیام پر بھی رپورٹ پیش کی جائے. اجلاس کو افرادی قوت بالخصوص نوجوانوں کیلئے روزگار کے مواقع پر تفصیلی بریفنگ دی گئی. بریفنگ میں بتایا گیا کہ ڈیجیٹل یوتھ ہب میں 8 لاکھ نوجوان رجسٹر ہو چکے ہیں. بیرون ملک تعمیرات، زراعت، سیاحت، صحت، ٹرانسپورٹ، بائیوٹیکنالوجی، مینیوفیکچرنگ، شپ بلنڈنگ، انفارمیشن ٹیکنالوجی، انجینئرنگ، نرسنگ، دواسازی اور اشیاء خورونوش کی تیاری کے شعبوں میں روزگار کے مواقع موجود ہیں. ان شعبوں میں پاکستانیوں کو روزگار فراہم کرنے کیلئے تربیتی پروگرام جاری ہیں. پاکستانی سفارتخانے مختلف ممالک میں میسر روزگار کے مواقع اور ان کیلئے درکار قابلیت ڈیجیٹل یوتھ ہب پورٹل پر فراہم کریں گے. اجلاس میں نائب وزیرِ اعظم و وزیرِ خارجہ سینیٹر محمد اسحاق ڈار، وفاقی وزراء ڈاکٹر مصدق ملک، عطاء اللہ تارڑ، چوہدری سالک حسین، وزیرِ مملکت بلال اظہر کیانی، چیئرمین نیوٹیک راجا قمر الاسلام، چیئرمین وزیرِ اعظم یوتھ پروگرام رانا مشہود احمد خان اور متعلقہ اعلی حکام نے شرکت کی. मुख्यमंत्री श्रीमती रेखा गुप्ता ने माननीय उपराज्यपाल श्री तरनजीत सिंह संधू के साथ बैठक कर ‘बाल संरक्षण माह’ के अंतर्गत चल रहे व्यापक POCSO जागरूकता अभियान एवं बच्चों की सुरक्षा से जुड़े कार्यों की समीक्षा की। जुलाई के अंत तक दिल्ली के सभी 5,633 विद्यालयों में POCSO के अनुरूप बाल संरक्षण समितियों का गठन सुनिश्चित किया जाएगा। साथ ही विद्यालयों, आंगनवाड़ी-सह-पालना घरों, बाल देखभाल संस्थानों और जिला बाल संरक्षण इकाइयों के माध्यम से प्रशिक्षण, जनजागरूकता, साइबर सुरक्षा, आत्मरक्षा तथा POCSO जागरूकता अभियान को और सशक्त किया जाएगा। शिक्षा विभाग, महिला एवं बाल विकास विभाग तथा दिल्ली पुलिस के संयुक्त दल नियमित निरीक्षण के माध्यम से सुरक्षा व्यवस्थाओं की निगरानी करेंगे। दिल्ली सरकार बच्चों की सुरक्षा सुनिश्चित करने और उनके लिए सुरक्षित वातावरण के निर्माण के लिए पूर्णतः प्रतिबद्ध है। @SandhuTaranjitS

India is the world's largest producer and exporter of rice, yet the Food Corporation of India (FCI) is holding rice stocks that are nearly five times the prescribed buffer norm, at a carrying cost of over Rs. 10,712 crores in FY25. In their latest article, Ashok Gulati, Ritika Juneja, and Purvi Thangaraj trace this surplus to three interlinked policy distortions: open-ended MSP procurement, with several states offering bonuses above the MSP; free electricity and heavily subsidised urea. Instead of addressing these underlying distortions, the government's response has been to divert surplus rice to ethanol production, supplying rice to distilleries at Rs. 23/kg despite FCI's economic cost of about Rs. 44/kg on the justification that it is broken and damaged rice. The authors also highlight the environmental costs of the current policy framework, including the use of ~ 4,000 litres of water to produce one kilogram of rice, high methane emissions from paddy cultivation, and nitrate contamination of groundwater associated with serious health risks. To address these challenges, the authors recommend capping state procurement at 40% of production, discontinuing state MSP bonuses, limiting free PDS supplies to the most vulnerable households, shifting ethanol production towards maize, and replacing fertiliser subsidies with direct income support. Assented the Central Bank of Kenya (Amendment) Bill, 2026, ushering in sweeping reforms aimed at strengthening the CBK’s capacity to safeguard financial stability, improve banking oversight, and modernise the country’s monetary policy framework. The new law introduces a distinct legal framework separating the Central Bank’s routine monetary policy operations from Emergency Liquidity Assistance (ELA). The move will improve Kenya’s preparedness to respond to financial crises while protecting taxpayers and the banking sector. Under the amendment, ELA can only be extended to banks that meet strict conditions on solvency, viability, and systemic risk. The provision aims to separate ordinary liquidity management from extraordinary interventions during periods of financial distress. One of the key reforms elevates financial system stability and sound banking regulation as secondary objectives of the Central Bank, while retaining price stability as its primary mandate. The law formally recognises the CBK’s role in promoting the integrity, resilience, and proper functioning of Kenya’s financial system. Additionally, to enhance governance, nominees for Deputy Governor positions will now be vetted and approved by the National Assembly before appointment. The provision aligns their process with that of the Governor and reinforces parliamentary oversight of senior leadership at the monetary authority. The amendment also gives statutory backing to the CBK’s training mandate through the Central Bank of Kenya Institute of Monetary Studies. It also provides a legal framework for collaboration with national, regional, and international institutions to enhance knowledge sharing and cross-border cooperation. The law further updates various provisions by replacing references to the defunct Deposit Protection Fund Board with the Kenya Deposit Insurance Corporation, bringing the Act in line with the current deposit protection framework. It also expands legal clarity on CBK’s authority to deal in gold and other precious metals as part of reserve management. This will support growth of Kenya’s mining sector and aligns Kenya with practices in Tanzania, Ghana, and South Africa. Also signed into law the Parliamentary Pensions (Amendment) Bill, 2023, bringing in reforms that align the parliamentary pension framework with the Constitution and extend benefits to both Members of the National Assembly and the Senate. The legislation updates the Parliamentary Pensions Act of 1983, which became outdated after the promulgation of the 2010 Constitution established a bicameral Parliament. The new law formally recognises both the National Assembly and the Senate in the administration of parliamentary pensions and ensures senators are entitled to benefits under the same framework as MPs. Among the major reforms, the law redefines “child” to mean a person below 18 years, up from 16 years, to conform with the Constitution. The Act further reconstitutes the Parliamentary Pensions Management Committee and the Appeals Committee to include representation from both Houses, reflecting Kenya’s bicameral structure. To preserve public service pension policy, the amended law retains gratuity payments only for legislators who serve less than five years.

The U.S. Department of Energy instructed AI data centers to stop using electricity from the main power grid. As temperatures exceeded 100 degrees Fahrenheit across much of the eastern United States Energy Secretary Chris Wright ordered data centers and other major electricity consumers on the PJM grid to switch to backup generators. The purpose was to conserve power so that homes could continue running air conditioners during one of the hottest periods of the year. The PJM grid serves 13 states and includes northern Virginia which hosts the largest cluster of data centers in the world. These centers support AI systems cloud computing streaming services and much of the internet but they require massive amounts of electricity. Officials explained that backup generators would ease strain on the grid and help avoid blackouts while millions of air conditioners operated at peak levels. This action illustrates how the rapid growth of AI infrastructure is starting to compete with regular household electricity needs during extreme heat waves. There are drawbacks to the solution. Most backup generators burn diesel or natural gas which creates more local air pollution than power from large plants. The region also has limited battery storage compared to states like California and Texas making it challenging to handle demand surges with cleaner sources. As AI data centers expand across the country experts predict that extreme heat events will increasingly challenge the ability of the power grid to meet both technological and everyday needs.

Rural development is one of the most powerful investments we can make in global prosperity, food security and stability. Small farms of up to five hectares produce around half of the world’s food. Behind this are rural women, men and young people working at the first mile of food systems — growing food, powering local economies and building resilient communities. On World Rural Development Day, we recognize their essential role. At @IFAD, we invest in the first mile of food systems — where rural people, their skills and their enterprises drive lasting change for their communities. These investments increase production, improve access to markets, strengthen value chains and build resilience to shocks. When rural communities have access to finance, technology and opportunity, incomes grow, food security improves and societies become more stable and resilient. #WorldRuralDevelopmentDay | #FinancingTheFirstMile Video

حامد میر صاحب، آپ اس وقت انجان بننے کے بجائے اپنے اس روتے ہوئے دوست کا ہاتھ تھامتے اور اس کے آنسو پونچھتے ہوئے اسے بتاتے کہ میرے دوست! ذرا پاکستان کے دل میں جھانک کر تو دیکھو۔ پاکستان نے گزشتہ 78 برسوں میں اگر بھارت کے ساتھ کسی ایک مسئلے پر سب سے زیادہ ثابت قدمی دکھائی ہے تو وہ صرف اور صرف کشمیر ہے۔ ہماری جنگیں، ہماری سفارت کاری، ہمارے عالمی مؤقف، ہمارے قومی بیانیے اور ہماری اجتماعی سوچ کا محور ہمیشہ کشمیر رہا ہے۔ ہم نے تجارت، معاشی مفادات اور بہت سے سفارتی مواقع کو پسِ پشت ڈالا، مگر کشمیر کے معاملے پر کبھی سمجھوتہ نہیں کیا۔ Realpolitik کے ماہرینِ ہمیں بارہا یہ مشورہ دیتے رہے کہ قومیں اپنے تنازعات کو ایک طرف رکھ کر تجارت اور ترقی کی راہ اختیار کرتی ہیں، لیکن پاکستان نے ہر دور میں کشمیر کو اپنے قومی ضمیر کا مقدمہ سمجھا۔ آپ کو کہنا چاہیے تھا کہ اقوامِ متحدہ کی بلند و بالا عمارتوں میں جب پاکستانی نمائندے کھڑے ہوتے ہیں تو ان کی آواز میں لاکھوں کشمیریوں کی چیخیں گونجتی ہیں۔ وہ محض تقریریں نہیں کرتے، وہ قسمیں کھاتے ہیں، وہ عہد دہراتے ہیں، وہ کہتے ہیں کہ جب تک پاکستان زندہ ہے، کشمیری تنہا نہیں! حتیٰ کہ جب ڈونلڈ ٹرمپ نے کشمیر کا ذکر کیا تو پاکستان نے اسے اپنی سفارتی کامیابی قرار دیا۔ کاش آپ اسے بتاتے کہ ہمارا تو نصاب بھی کشمیر کے تذکرے کے بغیر ادھورا ہے۔ ہمارے بچے کشمیر پر نظمیں پڑھتے ہیں، تقریریں کرتے ہیں اور یہ سیکھتے ہیں کہ کشمیر ہماری رگوں میں دوڑتا ہوا لہو ہے۔ ہم 5 فروری، 5 اگست اور 27 اکتوبر کو سڑکوں پر آ کر، ہاتھوں میں ہاتھ ڈال کر انسانی زنجیریں بناتے ہیں تاکہ دنیا کو بتا سکیں کہ کشمیریوں! تم اکیلے نہیں، ہم تمہارے ساتھ کھڑے ہیں۔ پاکستان نے خود معاشی بوجھ اٹھایا، اپنے شہریوں کا پیٹ کاٹا، لیکن آزاد جموں و کشمیر کے عوام کو بجلی، گیس، آٹا اور بنیادی ضرورتیں انتہائی کم نرخوں پر دیں۔ دنیا کی تاریخ میں کوئی ایسی مثال دکھا دیں جہاں ایک ریاست نے اپنے وسائل اس طرح اپنے بھائیوں پر نچھاور کیے ہوں؟ مگر ہم نے کبھی احسان نہیں جتایا، کبھی شکوہ نہیں کیا، کیونکہ بھائی، بھائیوں پر قربان ہونے کا شکوہ نہیں کرتے۔ حامد میر صاحب، آپ کے دوست صحافی رو رہے تھے، اور ہم سمجھتے ہیں ان کا درد۔ مگر آج کروڑوں پاکستانیوں کا درد بھی سنیے، ہم پاکستانیوں کا دل اس وقت ٹوٹا، جب ہم نے دیکھا کہ آزاد کشمیر کے جلسوں میں کچھ عاقبت نااندیش عناصر نے سٹیج پر کھڑے ہو کر پاکستان کو للکارا۔ جب پاکستان کے اس سبز ہلالی پرچم کی بے حرمتی کی گئی جس کے لیے ہمارے اور آپ کے بزرگوں نے اپنا سب کچھ لٹا دیا تھا۔ جب پاکستان کے ریاستی اداروں کی تضحیک کی گئی اور ایسے زہریلے نعرے لگائے گئے جنہیں سن کر روح کانپ اٹھی۔ کسی نے کہا کہ ”بلوچستان تو لاشیں واپس کرتا ہے، ہم تو آزاد کشمیر سے لاشیں بھی واپس نہیں کریں گے“۔ کسی نے ہمارے کشمیری بیٹوں کو اپنی ہی فوج کے خلاف بغاوت پر اکسایا، تو کسی نے الگ پاسپورٹ کی مانگ کی۔ اس لمحے ایسا لگا جیسے کسی نے ہم پاکستانیوں کے 78 برسوں کے خلوص، ہماری محبتوں اور ہماری قربانیوں کے جنازے پر کھڑے ہو کر قہقہہ لگایا ہو۔ حامد میر صاحب! آپ کو اپنے صحافی دوست کو یہ بھی بتانا چاہیے تھا کہ ان قوم پرستوں نے صرف پاکستان کے خلاف نعرے نہیں لگائے، بلکہ انہوں نے مقبوضہ کشمیر کے ان عظیم حریت پسندوں کی جدوجہد کو بھی نقصان پہنچایا جو برسوں تک ”تیری جان، میری جان، پاکستان“ کے نعرے لگاتے رہے، جو اپنے شہداء کو پاکستان کے سبز ہلالی پرچم میں لپیٹ کر سپردِ خاک کرتے رہے، اور جنہوں نے پاکستان سے اپنی محبت کو اپنی جدوجہد کا حصہ بنایا۔ اگر آج اس پرچم، اس نعرے اور اس نظریے کو کمزور کرنے کی کوشش کی جا رہی ہے تو یہ صرف پاکستان کے خلاف نہیں بلکہ ان ہزاروں کشمیری شہداء کی قربانیوں کے خلاف بھی ناانصافی ہے جنہوں نے اپنے خون سے اس تعلق کو مضبوط کیا تھا۔ کاش، میر صاحب! آپ ائیرپورٹ پر صرف اس صحافی کے آنسو نہ دیکھتے، بلکہ اپنے قلم کے ذریعے دنیا کو پاکستان کا موقف بھی دکھاتے۔ کاش آپ ان کروڑوں پاکستانیوں کے جذبات کی ترجمانی کرتے جو آج بھی کشمیر کا نام سن کر تڑپ اٹھتے ہیں اور جن کا دل کشمیر کے لیے دھڑکتا ہے! पद्म विभूषण तीजन बाई जी का निधन अत्यंत दुखद है। छत्तीसगढ़ की समृद्ध पंडवानी लोककला को अपनी विलक्षण प्रस्तुति से वैश्विक पहचान दिलाने में उनका योगदान सदैव अविस्मरणीय रहेगा। वे संगीत नाटक अकादमी पुरस्कार तथा संगीत नाटक अकादमी फ़ेलोशिप (अकादमी रत्न) से अलंकृत थीं। उन्हें वर्ष 1988 में पद्मश्री, 2003 में पद्म भूषण तथा 2019 में पद्म विभूषण से सम्मानित किया गया, जो भारतीय कला एवं संस्कृति के क्षेत्र में उनके असाधारण योगदान को रेखांकित करता है। उनका जाना भारतीय कला एवं संस्कृति जगत के लिए अपूरणीय क्षति है। संस्कृति मंत्रालय पद्म विभूषण तीजन बाई जी को भावभीनी श्रद्धांजलि अर्पित करता है। उनकी कला, साधना और समृद्ध विरासत आने वाली पीढ़ियों को निरंतर प्रेरित करती रहेगी।

The Strait of Hormuz was shut for three and a half months during the US-Iran conflict. This channel carries a fifth of the world's oil and most of India's cooking gas. While India came through it well with almost no petrol rationing, cylinders supply stable, crude spiked to $157 and came back down. But what if Hormuz closed for a year instead of a few months? The lasting fix isn't finding oil elsewhere. It's needing less of it, by electrifying transport and cooking. But that only works if India can build the technology involved, and four gaps stand in the way. First, the solar cell. India assembles modules at scale, but every high-efficiency cell made here runs on licensed foreign technology. Its top solar research centre has received $23 million in 15 years, less than deployment programmes spend in a fortnight. Second, the battery. India imports almost 100% of its lithium-ion cells. Its two biggest battery firms hold seven patents between them. China's CATL holds fifty thousand. Third, the steel the grid needs. India is the world's second-largest steelmaker, yet still imports the special steel every transformer needs, because, as the Ministry of Steel told Parliament, the technology "is not available with any Indian steelmaker." Fourth, the machines and materials underneath all three. Even factories built entirely in India often run on Chinese equipment and imported raw material. None of this means industrial policy failed. It built capacity fast. The actual problem is narrower — the schemes pay for production, not progress, so a factory running licensed tech qualifies for the same subsidy as one running something India invented. China fixed this exact problem by tying subsidy to a rising bar. Battery support was pegged to an energy-density floor that climbed every year; solar certifications expired every three years and had to be re-earned. Miss the bar, lose the money. That's why CATL and BYD exist, and why 400-odd Chinese EV startups that couldn't keep up were allowed to fail. India's fix isn't a bigger subsidy. It's a cheque with a rising, expiring technology condition attached, backed by real research funding, and open to unproven smaller firms instead of only the usual big names. The crisis was handled well, but it was a symptom. The real crisis is depending on the world for the fuel India burns and the technology to stop burning it. در بحث زبان همچون هویت، باید گفت که زبان فارسی، هویت مردم هزاره بود و می‌باشد. چرا می‌گویم بود؟ زیرا هیچ منبع تاریخی و هیچ داستان عامیانه‌ای در دل فرهنگ و حافظه‌ی جمعی و تاریخی هزاره‌ها نیست که آنان را در قالب گویندگان زبان دیگری نشان دهد. تمام داستان‌های هزارگی، بدون استثنا، به زبان فارسی است و همه‌ی راویان و گویندگان آن نیز فارسی‌زبان است. حتا داستان اَرَب‌بچه که اگر اَرَب را عرب بدانیم، بازهم قهرمان داستان، به زبان فارسی سخن می‌گوید. وانگهی، هیچ اثری در میان هزاره‌ها پیدا نشده که به زبان دیگری نوشته شده باشد، جز کتاب کهن اوستایی و چند قطعه‌ی کاغذی به زبان عبری که از بامیان به دست آمده است. حتا سنگ‌نبشته‌های دوران غزنویان و غوریان هزاره‌جات به زبان فارسی است. جغرافی‌دانان و مؤرخان، زبان مردم بامیان را شبیه به زبان بلخ نوشته‌اند. چرا می‌گویم زبان فارسی، هویت هزاره است؟ این‌جا باید درنگ کرد. بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/256810

According to the Associated Press, two Tennessee National Guard soldiers assigned to the Trump administration's Memphis Safe Task Force fatally shot an armed man during a foot pursuit early Sunday morning. Authorities say the soldiers, who were assisting Memphis Police in responding to reports of gunfire, opened fire after the suspect allegedly turned toward them with a firearm. The suspect was pronounced dead at the scene despite life-saving efforts by two National Guard medical specialists. No law enforcement personnel were injured. The Tennessee Bureau of Investigation is leading the investigation. FEMICIDIO DE AGOSTINA VEGA: CLAUDIO BARRELIER Y OSVALDO FASSETTA FUERON TRASLADADOS A UN PENAL DE MÁXIMA SEGURIDAD Claudio Barrelier, principal acusado por el femicidio de Agostina Vega, y Osvaldo Fassetta, imputado por encubrimiento agravado, fueron trasladados en las últimas horas al Complejo Carcelario N° 2 “Adjutor Andrés Abregú”, ubicado en la ciudad cordobesa de Cruz del Eje, una unidad de máxima seguridad. El operativo se realizó durante la madrugada del viernes 3 de julio y estuvo a cargo del Servicio Penitenciario de Córdoba, pocos días después de que el fiscal Raúl Garzón dictara la prisión preventiva para ambos. 3/3 The real breakthrough is economic. Unlike cruise missiles, the FAB-500 carries no engine or large fuel load—most of its weight is dedicated to the warhead. Russia can convert large Cold War-era bomb stockpiles using relatively inexpensive guidance kits, creating a difficult cost-exchange dilemma: intercept low-cost glide bombs with expensive air-defence missiles—or absorb repeated strikes on fixed positions. Sometimes the most disruptive military innovation isn’t a new weapon. It’s making an old one relevant again.

2/3 For decades, the FAB-500 was a conventional “dumb bomb” that required aircraft to overfly heavily defended targets. The UMPK wing-and-guidance kit changed that. Released from high altitude by aircraft such as the Su-34, it can glide roughly 40–70 km (depending on release conditions), allowing strikes from much greater stand-off distances while reducing exposure to enemy air defences. Simple upgrade. Major tactical impact.

1/3 🧵 The biggest battlefield disruptor in Ukraine today isn’t a stealth fighter or a hypersonic missile. It’s a Cold War-era FAB-500 gravity bomb fitted with a simple UMPK glide kit. A weapon designed decades ago is now reshaping modern air warfare—proving that innovation isn’t always about building something new. 👇

در آن چاشت گرم، آفتاب تند بالای سر ما می‌تابید و ما در امتداد کوچه‌ی نزدیک خانه‌ی‌مان، سنگینی نگاه‌های پرسشگر کسانی را حس می‌کردیم که دیگر با حضور نیمی از جمعیت خود سر ناسازگاری دارد. با خواهر کوچکم وارد رستورانتی شدیم که پیش از این پاتوق خانوادگی و فضایی برای دورهمی‌های صمیمانه بود. جایی که روزگاری صدای خنده‌ی کودکان و گفت‌وگوهای آرام دوست و اعضای خانواده در آن می‌پیچید. اما نخستین چیزی که به محض ورود بر سرم آوار شد، تضاد عریان و تکان‌دهنده‌ای بود که میان قلمرو مردان و زنان ترسیم کرده بودند. سالن عمومی و مردانه‌ی رستورانت، وسیع، روشن و دارای پنجره‌های بزرگ رو به چشم‌انداز روشن بود که به مشتریان مرد امکان می‌داد تا از تماشای فضای بیرون لذت ببرند. در مقابل، ما را با شتاب به سمت انتهای سالن و فضایی هدایت کردند که با تابلوی کوچک «بخش فامیلی» مشخص شده بود. این بخش که سهم زنان از کل رستورانت بود، فضای بسیار کوچکی داشت که گویی از حاشیه‌های بی‌مصرف سالن اصلی دزدیده شده بود. محیطی تنگ، نفس‌گیر و به غایت دلگیر با دیوارهای تیره و میز و چوکی کهنه و فرسوده. میزها نزدیک به هم چیده شده بودند و نور طبیعی تقریبا هیچ وجود نداشت. اما عمق فاجعه در پنجره‌های این اتاق متجلی می‌شد. با لایه‌ای ضخیم از روکش‌های تیره و کدر پوشانده شده بودند تا کوچک‌ترین روزنه‌ای برای دیده‌شدن زنان باقی نماند. مالکان رستورانت حتما به دستور مأموران طالبان، برای تضمین این نامرئی‌سازی مطلق، فراتر از روکش‌ها رفته و فریم آهنی پنجره‌ها و حتا دریچه‌های کوچک بالای آن‌ها را با جوشکاری محکم بسته بودند تا مبادا دستی زنانه برای لمس هوای بیرون پنجره‌ای را باز کند. بیشتر بخوانید: storage.googleapis.com/quriu…

Bodycam footage released by the New York City Police Department shows the arrest of one of the two people who climbed to the top of the Empire State Building on Wednesday, July 1. The footage shows an officer – secured by a harness – climbing up a ladder near the top of the spire, where he meets one of the trespassers. The officer is heard saying, “You can’t be up here.” She replies, “I don’t speak English,” and later says the pair are Russian. The officer puts the trespasser in cuffs. The video ends before the other trespasser is detained. The trespassers appeared to be a woman and man wearing masks and holding a banner that read, “When the power of love beats the love of power the world knows peace,” a quote attributed to Jimi Hendrix, according to CBS New York. The NYPD warned residents to expect street closures near 5th Avenue and 34th Street, where the Empire State Building is located, due to police activity. Video

Walmart just got sued for secretly recording customer voiceprints when they called customer service. But here's the full picture because this story is bigger than one lawsuit. Walmart is currently being sued for biometric data collection three separate ways simultaneously: — customer voiceprints captured during service calls. — warehouse worker voiceprints collected via headsets to track inventory and monitor workers. — facial recognition cameras in stores capturing shoppers' face geometry and uploading it to a database. three biometric collection systems. one company. now the wider picture: Walmart is not alone. this is an industry pattern. McDonald's, Applebee's, Chipotle, Domino's, Wingstop, Red Lobster, and Portillo's have all been sued for capturing customer voiceprints when people called to place orders. you called to order a pizza. they built a voice profile. Verizon enrolled customers in voice ID during service calls without telling them. Your voiceprint is not a password. you cannot change it. If Walmart's database gets breached and company databases do too, your voice is permanently compromised. every future voice authentication system you use is now at risk. and this is only illegal in Illinois. BIPA is the only US biometric law that lets individuals sue. In 47 other states, companies can collect your voiceprint, face scan, or fingerprints without legal consequence. The "just call customer service" pipeline has been a biometric data-collection pipeline for years. you just didn't know.

The 27th of June 1940 was not a good day for No. 235 Squadron. Six Blenheims of the squadron took off from Bircham Newton at 1250 hrs to conduct a reconnaissance flight to the Netherlands to observe the enemy troop build-up around the Zuider Zee. While flying over the area, the formation experienced heavy and accurate anti-aircraft fire. This broke up the formation, which was then set upon by a group of enemy Me 109 fighters. Out of the six aircraft, two Blenheims, piloted by Squadron Leader R.N. Clarke and Flying Officer R.J. Peacock, managed to fight their way out of the aerial melee. The remaining four aircraft were all shot down, with the loss of 11 aircrew killed and one taken as a prisoner of war. Those lost were the following: P/O H.S. Pardoe-Williams P/O E.A. Saunders Sgt C.W. Thorley P/O A.R. Wales Sgt J.W. Needham Sgt T.C. Jordon P/O P. Well Sgt S.K. Barlett Sgt A. Kempster P/O J.R. Cronan Sgt P.L. Lloyd Sgt A.O. Lancaster (POW) The recollections of Sgt Aubrey Lancaster, the sole survivor of the flight that day, appeared in a copy of Air Mail magazine in 2008. He recalled: “...Soon the flak stopped—when the flak stops, start looking for fighters, and we didn’t have to wait long. I didn’t see where our attack came from, except that a burst came through the fuselage, one bullet nicking my ankle and one hitting John Cronan in the shoulder, and he slumped forward over the controls. I got hold of him with some idea of getting into his seat and taking over, but John came round. Another burst of fire settled it, the starboard engine caught fire, and John screamed for me to get out.” “At this point, I looked back down the fuselage and saw Sgt Philip Lloyd, the gunner, slumped over his guns with bullet holes in his back. I went forward to open the downward hatch, but nothing happened. I stamped on it and jumped on it, but it wouldn’t budge. Whilst battling with the trapdoor, I looked ahead and saw that we were in a dive headed for some cattle and decided there was no future in staying where I was, so I turned to go out of the top hatch. I climbed into a position where I was half in, half out, wondering how I could possibly manage to get onto the wing and slide off in an effort to miss the tail-plane, when there came a bang and one hell of a bump, and I lost consciousness. When I came to, I was falling head over heels. I went to pull my rip-cord, but to my dismay there was no parachute. I looked around, and there was a pack floating above my head, some five to six feet away. I pulled it towards me by the straps and pulled the rip-cord, and it opened. I remember thinking what a big thing it was, and I looked down and hit the ground. I reckon it had opened 20 to 30 feet off the deck...” Aubrey Lancaster was captured shortly after landing on the ground. He was taken to where the body of his pilot, John Cronan, lay: “...and there was my pilot, John Cronan, lying underneath his parachute, which had burst open on impact. He had gone out of the top hatch, and the tail-plane had hit him... I am afraid I just went to pieces for a while and shed a few tears. We had been great pals for what seemed like ages.” Back at Bircham Newton, the entry in the squadron’s war diary reflected the sombre mood as the missing were listed: “These four pilots and their ‘Gunners’, all old members of this squadron, are a great personal loss, as they represent all that is left of the original squadron. As this action took place over the Zuider Zee, it is hoped that some of them escaped.” It is 86 years ago today this flight took place and Aubrey Lancaster survived the terrifying ordeal, being captured as a POW. (Photo taken of No. 235 Squadron Blenheim’s at Bircham Newton.)

Israeli authorities continue to withhold the body of 17-year-old Walid Ahmad from his family, despite the conclusion of the internal judicial investigation into his death. The high schooler from the West Bank town of Silwad, was arrested in September 2024 for allegedly throwing stones. After six months of detention without a trial date, he collapsed and died in Megiddo Prison in March 2025. An autopsy revealed extreme weight loss, muscle wasting, and severe malnutrition. An independent doctor observing the procedure stated that starvation was the likely leading cause of death. He also suffered from untreated illnesses like scabies and an intestinal infection. An Israeli court acknowledged that the teenager was starved in custody, but ruled that a direct, definitive causal link between the starvation and the immediate cause of death could not be legally proven. No indictments were filed and the judge closed the investigation into his death. ⚡️This chart is the largest destruction of household wealth in recorded history, executed deliberately by the state that owned it. And the world's gold bid is its shadow. Twenty years of real gains gone means the primary savings vehicle of 1.4 billion people, sixty to seventy percent of Chinese household wealth, round-tripped to 2006. Nothing in the American 2008 experience approaches this scale. The transmission runs from real estate to gold, the Chinese piggy bank. That connects this chart directly to the nineteen-month PBoC accumulation streak and the retail gold frenzy running through Shanghai and Shenzhen. The domestic store of value died, the capital account is closed, and the surviving vessels inside the wall are gold, deposits yielding nothing, and quietly, Hong Kong crypto rails. The sovereign gold bid and the household gold bid are the same event: capital fleeing a dead asset class with nowhere else to go. This chart is why gold took the fiscal-hedge flow all year. The deliberateness is the part Western commentary refuses to metabolize. Xi drew the three red lines in August 2020, and the chart peaks within months. "Houses are for living, not for speculation" was a demolition order, executed to redirect national capital from land finance into manufacturing and strategic technology. The demolition succeeded and then kept falling past the point of control, which is the signature failure mode of command economies: they can start avalanches and cannot stop them. The state chose this trade, prosperity of the household balance sheet exchanged for industrial supremacy, and the chart is the receipt. What it does to the world: a China that cannot sell its citizens apartments sells the world overcapacity instead. The property bust is the engine of the export deflation machine, EVs, solar, chemicals, chips at the mature nodes, flooding out at prices that reflect a state subsidizing employment rather than seeking margin. The darkest layer sits in legitimacy mechanics. The Party's compact was prosperity for obedience, and the prosperity was denominated in apartments. A regime that can no longer deliver the wealth escalator has two remaining legitimacy channels: nationalism and security. Every percentage point this index falls raises the marginal value of the Taiwan card, the anti-American frame, the external enemy. The chart does not predict war. It repriced the incentive structure that decides one, and the direction of the repricing is unambiguous. The compressions: The gold thesis strengthens at its root, because the largest population on earth just lost its default asset and the replacement flow has years to run. The US disinflation-in-goods leg has a structural sponsor. And the "China's fine" versus "China collapses" debate is two wrong answers to one question. The true state is a managed, chronic, exported depression, too controlled to break, too deep to fix, and the rest of the world's asset prices are already living inside its consequences. Happy 250th Birthday, America! 🇺🇸 Kim and I have both found ourselves especially emotional as our nation celebrates this historic milestone. Just days ago, it was one of the greatest honors of my life to stand on the National Mall and sing as America officially began its 250th birthday celebration. It was a moment neither of us will ever forget. Today, we reflect on the courage of our Founding Fathers, the providential hand of God that guided them, and the remarkable victory that secured our independence. We remember the wisdom that gave us the Declaration of Independence and the Constitution, and we honor every generation of brave Americans who has defended the freedoms we enjoy today. For nearly 250 years, America has remained a beacon of hope to the world. Ours is a nation founded on faith, freedom, personal responsibility, and the belief that our rights come from God, not from government. Those ideals are worth protecting, celebrating, and passing on to our children and grandchildren. For more than half of my life, I have had the incredible privilege of singing the song I wrote about my love for this country. It has never been just a song. It has always been my heart. Tonight, I will have the privilege of once again singing for all of America as we celebrate this historic occasion, standing alongside our great President, Donald J. During the filming of Gone With the Wind in 1939, Clark Gable noticed that the restrooms on set had signs saying “White” and “Colored.” This meant Hattie McDaniel and other Black actors were not allowed to use the same restrooms as white actors. Gable was very upset. He told the director that if the signs were not taken down, he would quit the movie. The studio, afraid of losing him, removed the signs. Clark Gable also showed kindness to Hattie McDaniel in other ways. He sat with her, ate with her, and treated her with respect when many people at the time did not. Their friendship stood out in a world full of unfair rules. Later, McDaniel made history as the first Black actor to win an Oscar, a moment that opened doors for many others after her.

A lot of malware campaigns use CloudFlare to mask their C2 infrastructure. They do this for a few reasons, but the primary reason is that it delays the inevitable of their C2 being taken down. The malware developers using CloudFlare isn't necessarily bad, and it isn't necessarily good, it's just a known thing that people abuse. Yes, CloudFlare did their job. CloudFlare takes down malware infrastructure a lot, despite people saying CloudFlare doesn't take any action, because CloudFlare is inundated with both legitimate and illegitimate takedown requests and reports daily. The daily reports they receive are (probably) in the millions daily. If they didn't want to hide behind CloudFlare, the malware developers could also have used a compromised website (very common), or Discord, or Google docs, or Spotify, or ... basically pick a website and service and it can be abused with enough elbow grease. The easiest, fastest, and easily configurable method is generic host with CloudFlare. When the domain is taken down, or CloudFlare takes it down, they simple spin up new infrastructure with a new CloudFlare account and operations resume as normal. Mary-Ann Russon (@concertina226) So basically, what you’re saying is that Cloudflare did their job? Or that the malware authors are shit? OTRO EFECTO MUNDIAL 2026: LAS VENTAS MINORISTAS DE LOS COMERCIOS PYME CRECIERON EN JUNIO De todos modos, dice un relevamiento de la Cámara Argentina de la Mediana Empresa (CAME), cayeron respecto de mayo y registran una retracción del 2,5% en el primer semestre del año Durante el mes de junio, las ventas minoristas del segmento pyme aumentaron el 0,9% a valores constantes, pero la medición intermensual arrojó una baja del 1,3%, consolidando una retracción acumulada del 2,5% durante el primer semestre del año, informó la Confederación Argentina de la Mediana Empresa (CAME). Según la entidad, el incremento en la medición interanual se debió a la inyección de liquidez derivada del cobro del aguinaldo y el movimiento generado por el Mundial de fútbol. En cuanto al desempeño sectorial, cuatro de los rubros relevados presentaron un desempeño interanual positivo. Las mayores tasas de crecimiento correspondieron a Perfumería (+9,5%) y Farmacia (+5,4%), seguidas por Alimentos y bebidas (+2,9%) y Textil e indumentaria (+1,9%). Las ramas que registraron variaciones negativas fueron Bazar, decoración y muebles (-3,1%), Ferretería, materiales eléctricos y de la construcción (-2%) y Calzado y marroquinería (-1%). 🔗infob.ae/4eMbP9F

RADIOGRAFÍA DE LA GRAN CARRERA DE COLAPINTO EN EL GP DE GRAN BRETAÑA DE F1: GRAN LARGADA, SOBREPASOS Y MÁS PUNTOS | Por Darío Coronel El argentino concretó una notable labor en Silverstone, ya que ganó diez posiciones. Volvió a cosechar unidades y terminó delante de su compañero Pierre Gasly Franco Colapinto cumplió una notable tarea en el Gran Premio de Gran Bretaña de Fórmula 1, ya que ganó diez lugares y sumó dos puntos en el histórico Autódromo de Silverstone por la novena fecha de la temporada. El argentino, a bordo de su Alpine A526, terminó delante de su compañero de equipo Pierre Gasly. En el histórico escenario que fue sede de la primera carrera de la Máxima el 13 de mayo de 1950, este domingo la carrera fue a 52 vueltas en el circuito de 5.891 metros. Franco comenzó 19º con neumáticos medios e hizo una gran largada que lo ubicó en el puesto 15º. Peleó con Nico Hülkenberg (Audi), quien lo había tocado en el inicio, y en la segunda vuelta el argentino superó al alemán para ubicarse en el 14º puesto. En el inicio hubo una polémica maniobra de Pierre Gasly contra Colapinto: al llegar a una curva a la izquierda, el francés le cerró el radio de giro a su compañero de equipo en Alpine y estuvieron a milímetros de tocarse. El argentino reclamó la situación por la radio en diálogo con su ingeniero, Stuart Barlow, quien le respondió “no hay nada que podamos hacer”. 🔗infob.ae/4bq3eXY

EL MOSQUITO DEL DENGUE APRENDE A IGNORAR REPELENTES Y DESAFÍA MÉTODOS DE CONTROL, SEGÚN UN ESTUDIO | Por Ismael Yasnikowski Una investigación francesa demostró que el Aedes aegypti puede asociar el aroma del DEET con la alimentación y así cambiar su respuesta, lo que abre nuevas interrogantes sobre el control de la enfermedad Un equipo internacional de científicos demostró que el mosquito transmisor del dengue, Aedes aegypti, puede aprender a “ignorar” el efecto de los repelentes químicos. El estudio, publicado en la revista Journal of Experimental Biology, muestra que estos insectos logran asociar el olor del repelente con estímulos positivos, como la presencia de alimento, y modifican de ese modo su respuesta instintiva de huida. De acuerdo con Radio France Internationale (RFI), en la investigación -liderada por Claudio Lazzari del Centro Nacional de Investigación Científica de Francia (CNRS) y Clement Vinauger de la Universidad Virginia Tech en Estados Unidos- se enfocaron en hembras de Aedes aegypti, el principal vector del dengue, y ponen en evidencia la notable capacidad de adaptación de estos insectos. Los hallazgos aportan nuevas claves para entender los retos en el control de enfermedades transmitidas por vectores, especialmente en zonas donde el dengue, la chikungunya y la fiebre amarilla continúan siendo amenazas persistentes para la salud pública. 🔗infob.ae/44htrUS

During the meeting, Haqqani expressed the ministry's readiness to cooperate in the delivery of healthcare services and emphasized the importance of joint efforts in this area. He also stated that political considerations should not hinder the provision of humanitarian assistance and healthcare services. The meeting was also attended by a representative of the King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief), the UNICEF Regional Director, and the ambassadors of the United Arab Emirates and Qatar. #TOLOnews_English

U.S. Naval Forces Central Command / U.S. 5th Fleet has announced it has suspended the search for the remaining missing crew member following the July 1 crash of an MH-60S Seahawk in the Arabian Sea. Over the course of the 102 hour search, U.S. Navy aircraft and ships covered more than 14,000 square miles. Three crew members were rescued shortly after the emergency water landing and remain in stable condition. The identity of the missing service member is being withheld pending notification of next of kin. The Navy has previously stated there are no indications the crash was the result of hostile fire. U.S. Naval Forces Central Command/U.S. 5th Fleet (@US5thFleet) The U.S. Navy suspended the active search for a Sailor assigned to Helicopter Sea Combat Squadron (HSC) 5 embarked aboard aircraft carrier USS George H.W. Bush (CVN 77), effective 3:00p.m. AST on July 5, 2026. The Sailor was reported missing July 1st, after an MH-60S helicopter went down in the Arabian Sea. The efforts concluded following an extensive search by the U.S. Navy and U.S. Air Force in the U.S. Central Command area of responsibility. The Sailor’s name is being withheld until at least 24 hours after next-of-kin notification is complete in accordance with Navy policy. For more than 102 hours, an extensive and coordinated search and rescue effort spanning over 14,000 square miles was conducted. The efforts brought together the USS George H.W. Bush carrier’s HSC 5 and Helicopter Maritime Strike Squadron (HSM) 46, the fixed wing aircraft of Carrier Air Wings (CVW) 7 and 9, aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln’s (CVN 72) helicopter squadrons HSC 14 and HSM 71, Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyers USS Ross (DDG 71), USS Donald Cook (DDG 75), USS Higgins (DDG 76), USS Mason (DDG 87), and USS John Finn (DDG 113) with HSM 51, two P-8 Poseidon squadrons, and multiple U.S. Air Force aircraft. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/US5thFleet/status/2073768949280313416#m
